metadata.description: Build an app with your own agent on your agent.cloud canvas.

plugins.description: Your own Claude or Codex builds your app with you on your agent.cloud canvas: it tries versions that differ on purpose, asks you at the forks that matter, and shows each one live.

plugins.name: canvas-v2
plugins.description: Canvas v2, for canvas-v2.ac0.app. Your apps on a canvas beside the chat: /canvas puts the app you are working on there, live from your machine, and your own Claude or Codex builds new versions with you.
